findings.title: The repaired XD-12 case and the new p6_impact coverage test are red on the integrated baseline: 8 applications/*/mcp/server.py modules map to no check
findings.evidence: Regression run (logs/addendum2_regression_run.stdout.txt) and the isolated re-run of its failures in a short-path detached checkout of 324d9dba3 (logs/failing_nodes_at_head.log): tests/qualification/pdc_x/xd/test_xd_12_evol_ent_audit.py::test_xd12_every_pdc_touched_product_module_maps_to_a_domain_check and tests/qualification/pdc_x/p6_impact/test_p6_impact_map_coverage.py::test_every_pdc_touched_product_module_maps_to_at_least_one_check fail with '8 PDC-touched product modules map to no check, e.g. applications/dispute_sim_application/mcp/server.py ...' (the eight MCP-RC server modules of dispute_sim, governed_contractor, intergrax_assistant, lab, legal, local_workspace, poc_template and research applications). Cause: both tests take git diff BASELINE_SHA..HEAD, which on mcp-rc includes the MCP-RC product changes; the new domain rules (PDC_DOMAIN_IMPACT_RULES) are all intergrax/* prefixes and no manifest entrypoint covers applications/*. At 19d552bee the XD-12 case was a strict xfail (so not red) and the p6_impact test did not exist (logs/failing15_nodes_at_prev.log). Whether the same two tests pass on development alone was not run here.
findings.impact: the ticket acceptance 'XD-12 finding 8 runs as a plain passing test' holds on development but not on the integrated mcp-rc baseline: the removal of the xfail turns a declared gap into a red test there (a gap is exposed, not hidden). A CHANGED-SINCE run over a range that contains the eight MCP servers selects only the invariant floor for them.
findings.disposition: ORCHESTRATOR_AND_OPERATOR_DECISION: either add rules for the applications/* roots to impact_map.py (a product path: voids ACT-N11 for it, needs another re-pin) or accept the red class on the integrated baseline until after the rebind; do not narrow the test (that would weaken a gate)

findings.evidence: tests/qualification/ebh_5/test_ebh_5_behavioral_package_c_v2.py::test_ebh5_pkgc_v2_dual_slug_integration[integration.embedding_provider] and ::test_ebh5_pkgc_v2_dual_slug_rpl_cde_equivalence[integration.embedding_provider] fail with UnknownIntegrationError "Integration slug 'ollama' is not registered in the catalog" (intergrax/integrations/providers/embedding_provider/ollama/register.py:20 -> catalog.augment_integration_contract_specs). They fail in isolation at 324d9dba3 and at 19d552bee and pass at the pin (logs/failing_nodes_at_head.log, failing15_nodes_at_prev.log, failing15_nodes_at_pin.log). Candidate origin: commit c3d5b7005 'B-REG-P single ollama catalog row for the embedding provider' (T-IGX-036-M), not diagnosed. findings.title: Thirty legacy C0xx ids in the platform rules (12 paths) are not manifest ids; the delta fixes only the map's own two files
findings.evidence: Probe P2 (logs/addendum_2_impact_map_probes.results.json): the shipped map names 30 ids that the 85-check manifest does not have (C002, C004, ..., C074), identical before and after the delta. The delta replaces C024/C029/C072 by ENT-A-EVOL-01..03 for impact_map.py and changed_since_impact_map.v1.json only (the code comment says so). changed_since.py (the selection logic itself), runner.py, validators.py, evidence.py, baseline.py, modes.py, sandbox.py, report.py, the report schema, the manifest JSON, build_impact_map.py and run_qual_wave.py still map to those phantom ids. Mutation M5 (logs/mutation_sample.stdout.txt) shows the consequence: a map file selecting legacy ids is caught by xd_12 (selected <= manifest_ids) and by p6_impact, so a change to any of the 12 other paths inside the PDC range makes the first XD-12 case red. tests/qualification/ent_audit_x/unit/test_changed_since_impact_map.py still asserts C024/C029 for changed_since.py.
findings.impact: a change to the CHANGED-SINCE selection logic or to the enterprise-audit runner selects no real domain check (only the floor); latent red in XD-12 when such a path next changes. Pre-existing weakness, not introduced by the delta.
findings.disposition: ROUTE_TO_ENT-AUDIT owner; separate ticket (a product path)

findings.area: impact map: adequacy of the mapping is not tested
findings.title: The tests prove that every touched module has some existing check id, not that it has a relevant one; mutations that reroute or shrink a rule survive
findings.evidence: Mutation sample on a scratch detached checkout (logs/mutation_sample.stdout.txt; control already red with the two F-41 tests, so a mutant counts as killed only by a new failure): M1 delete the runtime/security rule KILLED (representative-module test); M5 own files back to legacy ids KILLED; M6 unknown id KILLED; M2 reroute runtime/security to ENT-A-DOC-01 SURVIVED; M3 reroute runtime/agent_governance to ENT-A-DOC-01 SURVIVED; M4 shrink applications to one id SURVIVED; M7 weak catch-all prefix intergrax/runtime -> ENT-A-DOC-01 SURVIVED. Probe P3: for 19319 tracked files the selection by the new map never loses an id compared to the previous map except for the two own files (whose lost ids are not manifest ids), so the delta drops or reroutes nothing; the new rules only add (5780 files gain impact ids). Probes P6/P7: coverage stays partial: of 7046 intergrax python files 1676 have no impact id (previous map: 7037); of 259 governance/identity/authority/policy/tenant/auth python files 146 have none (fastapi_core/auth, runtime/governance, runtime/policy, runtime/human, ...); of 37 files with 'mcp' in the path 16 have none; the manifest has no MCP-specific check, so MCP modules (intergrax/applications/_shared/mcp_*) only receive the generic applications/contracts gates (ENT-A-BND-01, CTR-*, TYP-01, SEC-*, VBN-CONTRACT-LEAKAGE).
findings.impact: the map does not weaken any selection and gives MCP, identity and governance modules more checks than before, but a wrong or thinner mapping would not be detected by the tests; large parts of the governance and identity code remain at the invariant floor.
findings.disposition: ROUTE_TO_ENT-AUDIT owner and to IA-D6 (runtime security) / IA-D1; accept for the rebind
